sentences.en: Israel has intensified its collective punishment of the Palestinian people.
sentences.zh: 以色列加强了对巴勒斯坦人民集体惩罚的力度。

sentences.en: Algeria has intensified diplomatic effort to solve the Libyan crisis.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚加大了外交努力以解决利比亚危机。

sentences.en: The excitement intensifies! Who will win the prize for best actor?
sentences.zh: 激动人心的时刻来临！谁能获得最佳男演员奖？

senses.zh: 使加强，使强化；使变激烈
